description: Source code for the DeviceIdentification plugin class, implementing device ID retrieval and management within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: DeviceIdentification
classes.description: A plugin class responsible for managing device identification information, including initialization, cleanup, and data retrieval.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the device identification plugin, retrieves device properties, and sets subsystem identifiers.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and resets subsystem identifiers during plugin deinitialization.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns additional information about the device identification, currently empty.

methods.name: GetDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the device ID using the IIdentifier interface and system info.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Populates device information data structure with firmware version, chipset, and device ID.
